alerts.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 2 at 2:55AM EDT until October 2 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.areas: Nantucket Sound; Vineyard Sound; Buzzards Bay
alerts.description: * WHAT...Southwest winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt and seas around 3 feet expected. * WHERE...Nantucket Sound, Vineyard Sound and Buzzards Bay. * WHEN...From 11 AM this morning to 8 PM EDT this evening. * IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
alerts.instruction: Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
